data.narrative:
Blumen Systems is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Hannes Boehning that has raised $6.4M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises nine private peers and one public comparable (LNZA), including later-stage companies like Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. Stage-progression analysis, which applies a typical 2.5x multiplier to seed-stage financings, implies a post-money valuation of $16M when applied to the $6.4M raised as a proxy for enterprise value. Peer-median comparison was not executable; while nine same-sector peers exist, none satisfied minimum thresholds for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables, making a narrow peer set unachievable. A broader sectoral median would risk material skew given the heterogeneity of business models and maturity levels in climate tech.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $14M (low) to $18M (high), with a median of $16M. This range reflects conservative bounds around the single applicable method rather than triangulation across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the company's actual post-money from its most recent raise, unit economics relative to peer cohorts, and technology stage maturity—all of which would refine the estimate significantly.
